property_summary: For all inputs, the reference contract C only allows the fixed owner (from) to invoke transfer successfully (non-reverting); the mutant that removes the require allows non-owner callers to succeed, so there exist inputs where the mutant returns true but the reference would revert (i.e., caller-restriction property is violated).
change_summary: Change the required caller from the fixed address to any address (remove require on msg.sender) so transfer can be called by others, affecting return behavior when original would revert for non-owner callers.
